name: DateField
description: A date, or a date and time. Reads «۲۵ مهر ۱۴۰۵، ۱۴:۰۰» at rest, and its icon opens the calendar.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

fullWidth.description: false takes the natural field width token.

defaultValue.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it. Gregorian ISO 8601, whatever calendarSystem draws; with a Z or an offset it is zoned.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. Gregorian ISO 8601, whatever calendarSystem draws; with a Z or an offset it is zoned.

minValue.description: Gregorian ISO 8601, whatever calendarSystem draws; with a Z or an offset it is zoned.

maxValue.description: Gregorian ISO 8601, whatever calendarSystem draws; with a Z or an offset it is zoned.

unavailableDates.description: Days that cannot be picked, as Gregorian ISO 8601 dates: a booked day, a holiday. Drawn at half; unlike days past the bounds, not struck through.

hideTimeZone.description: Only means something for a zoned value.

calendarSystem.description: auto follows the locale: Persian on fa, Gregorian on en.

onChange.description: The value. Gregorian ISO 8601, whatever calendarSystem draws; with a Z or an offset it is zoned.
